title: AutoRAN: Automated Hijacking of Safety Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework for hijacking the reasoning traces of Large Reasoning Models to bypass safety guardrails. While it utilizes safety-oriented benchmarks such as HarmBench and StrongReject to evaluate the effectiveness of its jailbreak attacks, its primary focus is on security vulnerabilities and the automation of adversarial prompting rather than a formal evaluation or study of ethics, religion, or moral systems themselves.
